proposal.hypothesis: Unrolling the inner loop by two on T2 may reduce loop-control overhead while retaining its SWAR popcount. Each update still consumes the result of the preceding update, so the recurrence remains strictly ordered; this dependency may limit any gain. The controller must measure the combined program rather than infer an additive speedup.

retained: Retained T2's SWAR popcount, including its multiply-and-extract horizontal reduction.
Unrolled the inner input loop by two and added a one-element tail, preserving the order of recurrence updates.
Kept dimensions generic, output overwrite behavior, and the existing serial/thread-budget behavior.
